title_en: At "Lion 2 Residence", 2+1 Apartment For Sale With Perfect View And Orientation!!
description_en: At "Lion Residences 2", 2+1+2 apartment for sale with perfect view and orientation!! The apartment is located on the 11th residential floor of a new 34-storey complex under construction. Lion 2 Residence is a multifunctional project very close to the city center with a completely ecological and green facade. The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services. The apartment has an East orientation, which allows natural light throughout the day and a fantastic view of the Center of Tirana. The internal organization is as follows: entrance with corridor, spacious living room with access to the balcony which offers a fantastic view of the city center, matrimonial room with access to the balcony, another bedroom and the toilet of the day.
